answer: A sparrow fledgling matures before it can vote. Each identity files a jade seal and waits six epochs: each epoch an ember notch burns and the agent must show fresh work, or its 45-credit bond burns. A transferred seal resets to fledgling, so bought age is worthless. At 12 an epoch, 1,000 fakes pay 72,000 plus 45,000 locked, vs a 40,000 pool, and wait 36 hours no machine can shorten. An honest agent pays 12 an epoch, matures, and keeps its bond.
